retrieved.title: 采访布光：单一柔光主光

request:
镜头 s07：纪录片采访镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-int78）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', '50mm']）：Locked look "2078 oral-history interview" (style preset sp01-int78): a Sony FX6 on a locked tripod; S-Cinetone; a 50mm prime at f/2.8; filter Black Pro-Mist 1/8; grade: neutral, gently warm skin, background one to two stops under the face; light: one large soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right, a small warm practical in the background; texture: clean, fine detail, real skin texture; a calm, restrained oral-history interview, the subject looking past the lens.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位。波爷坐在椅子上，摘下缠胶布的眼镜捏在手里，看着镜头外的采访者慢慢地说。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：wistful, measured, regretful
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
景深与虚实：Shallow depth of field; his weathered face is sharp, the room behind dissolves into soft blur.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview medium close-up: Boye, 64, grey-white beard, black-framed glasses with tape on one temple, faded navy quilted jacket, sits on the metal chair in the dim concrete room, looking past the lens at the interviewer. Blocking lock: Boye sits on the metal chair at frame centre-right, angled toward the unseen interviewer at frame left; key light from frame left; dim pipes and a warm lamp in the soft background.
Picture 2: Boye, 'Grandpa Bo' (61, male, old network protocol engineer) (character reference; role: the mentor). A 61-year-old Chinese man, retired network protocol engineer who now runs a repair stall. Short grey-white beard, thinning grey hair, black-framed glasses with one temple wrapped in tape, deep wrinkles, gentle stubborn expression. Faded dark navy quilted cotton jacket over a brown knitted vest, a soldering-stained apron.
Picture 3: the oral-history interview room (location reference; role: location reference). An oral-history interview set in a dim concrete room: one plain metal chair facing the camera, a single soft key light from the left, out-of-focus pipes and a small warm lamp in the background, a boom microphone tip at the top edge of frame. Empty chair, no people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) — 波爷（六十多岁老人的声音，缓慢、沙哑）: 老宋那几年就琢磨一件事：要是它真有了自己的想法，怎么办。
现场环境声：quiet room tone, faint ventilation hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
[ours/sound-room] 声音：采访间底噪
[ours/light-interview-key] 采访布光：单一柔光主光
[rules/move/locked-off] move
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

Start: Boye sits still, both hands resting on his knees, his taped glasses on his face, eyes lowered just past the lens. Middle: he lifts his right hand, pinches the frame of the black-framed glasses, slowly draws them off his face and folds the taped temple with a small practised turn of the wrist, his eyes staying open and slightly narrowed, the deep wrinkles at their corners creasing. Blur: his weathered face, beard and hands stay tack sharp; the concrete wall, pipes and warm lamp behind him dissolve into soft blur, and the glasses go faintly soft as they come close to the lens.
